column1: Proof of Calm tax-year file · Netherlands · 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31
Data from your log. Not a tax computation.
Amounts are as you logged them and are not converted. Your pay currency is EUR.

Netherlands rules reviewed on 2026-11-05 · general information, not advice · Sources: https://www.belastingdienst.nl/wps/wcm/connect/nl/werk-en-inkomen/content/aangifte-doen-en-belasting-betalen-met-cryptos
units_on_01-01 is your log at the start of 2026-01-01, which is the end of 2025-12-31. units_on_12-31 stays empty until the year has ended.
This file holds units and logged amounts but no market prices, so the value_on_01-01 and value_on_12-31 cells are empty, except 0.00 where you held none.
Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Amounts and units use a decimal point.
The tax year ends on 2026-12-31. This file shows your log as of 2026-10-20.
